patterns_found.name: Change of Character (CHoCH)
patterns_found.evidence: Prior bearish structure with lower highs and lows from 1900 down to 1725. Price formed a higher low around 1775 and broke above the prior swing high at approximately 1825. Current price at 1835.75 confirms bullish structure shift.

patterns_found.name: Inverse Head and Shoulders
patterns_found.evidence: Three distinct lows visible: left shoulder near 1775, head near 1725, right shoulder near 1775-1800. Neckline resistance around 1800-1825. Price currently trading above neckline at 1835.75.

patterns_found.name: Bullish Flag
patterns_found.evidence: Strong impulse rally followed by consolidation near recent highs. Price action around 1820-1840 suggests potential flag formation after the upward move.

vlm_analysis.visual_evidence: Price shifted from downtrend to uptrend, breaking key resistance at 1825 after forming higher low at 1775. Inverse H&S structure visible with neckline breakout. Volume spike accompanied the upward move.
